probes.question: Which appeared first: the oldest shark relatives (about 439 million years ago) or the earliest known trees (about 385 million years ago)?
True or false: the earliest known trees lived about 385 million years ago.

image.alt: A blacktip reef shark swimming just below the surface in clear blue water.

body.claim: Sharks' ancestors were swimming before there were any trees.
body.why: The oldest shark relatives, known as spiny sharks, appeared around 439 million years ago. The earliest known trees, such as Wattieza, grew about 385 million years ago.
